document.lead: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

text: Supermarket shelves in most countries now carry fruit, grain and meat from every continent. This essay will discuss whether nations should aim to feed themselves or rely on international trade, before arguing that a combination of both offers the greatest security.

Those who favour domestic production emphasise security. Recent years have shown how quickly global supply chains can be disrupted by pandemics, wars or extreme weather, and countries that depend heavily on imported grain may face sudden shortages and soaring prices. Producing food at home also supports farmers and rural communities, preserves agricultural knowledge and reduces the emissions caused by transporting goods over long distances.

On the other hand, supporters of trade argue that no country can efficiently grow everything. Climates and soils differ, so it makes economic sense for each nation to specialise in what it produces best and buy the rest. Kazakhstan, for example, is a major exporter of wheat but would find it extremely costly to grow tropical fruit. Imports therefore keep prices lower and give consumers a far wider choice, while also providing export income for poorer farming nations.

In my view, the wisest policy lies between these extremes. Each country should be able to produce enough staple foods, such as grain, vegetables and dairy products, to survive a crisis, while continuing to import what it cannot grow efficiently. This balance protects citizens without sacrificing the benefits of trade.

In conclusion, self-sufficiency offers security and supports rural life, whereas trade offers lower prices and variety. A country that secures its basic needs at home while remaining open to imports gains the advantages of both.

note.en: States the plan of the essay.
Adds a second argument for the same side.
note.ru: Добавляет второй довод той же стороны.

note.en: A result: since climates differ, specialising makes sense.
note.kk: Салдар: климат әртүрлі болғандықтан, мамандану тиімді.
note.ru: Следствие: раз климат разный, специализация выгодна.

note.en: A conclusion: hence lower prices and choice.
note.kk: Қорытынды: төмен баға мен таңдау осыдан туады.
note.ru: Вывод: отсюда низкие цены и выбор.

note.en: Adds one more benefit of trade.
Compares the two sides in one sentence.
note.ru: Сравнивает две стороны в одном предложении.

strengths.en: Pandemics and wars as causes of disruption — a point every reader understands.
strengths.kk: Үзілістердің себебі ретінде пандемия мен соғыс — кез келген оқырманға түсінікті дәлел.
strengths.ru: Пандемии и войны как причины перебоев — довод, понятный любому читателю.
strengths.example: how quickly global supply chains can be disrupted by pandemics, wars or extreme weather

strengths.en: Wheat versus tropical fruit is a clear example of the benefit of specialisation.
strengths.kk: Бидай мен тропикалық жемістер — маманданудың пайдасын көрнекі көрсететін мысал.
strengths.ru: Пшеница и тропические фрукты — наглядный пример выгоды специализации.
strengths.example: Kazakhstan, for example, is a major exporter of wheat

strengths.en: The writer does not just choose the middle; he names what to produce at home.
strengths.kk: Автор жай «ортасын» жақтамайды, өзімізде нақты не өндіру керегін атайды.
strengths.ru: Автор не просто «за середину», а называет, что именно производить у себя.
strengths.example: enough staple foods, such as grain, vegetables and dairy products, to survive a crisis

strengths.en: A two-sentence conclusion with no repetition and no new ideas.
strengths.kk: Қорытынды екі сөйлемде, қайталаусыз және жаңа идеясыз.
strengths.ru: Вывод в двух предложениях без повторов и новых идей.

note.en: Introduction: a familiar image (supermarket shelves), the plan and a hint of the position — a combination.
note.kk: Кіріспе: таныс көрініс (супермаркет сөрелері), эссенің жоспары және ұстанымға меңзеу — ұштастыру.
note.ru: Введение: знакомая картина (полки супермаркета), план эссе и намёк на позицию — сочетание.

note.en: The first view — home production: security in a crisis, support for villages, the environment.
note.kk: Бірінші көзқарас — өз өндірісі: дағдарыс кезіндегі қауіпсіздік, ауылды қолдау, экология.
note.ru: Первая точка зрения — своё производство: безопасность при кризисах, поддержка сёл, экология.

note.en: The second view — trade: specialisation with the example of Kazakh wheat, prices and choice.
note.kk: Екінші көзқарас — сауда: Қазақстан бидайы мысалымен мамандану, баға және таңдау.
note.ru: Вторая точка зрения — торговля: специализация с примером пшеницы Казахстана, цены и выбор.

note.en: The writer’s view: staple foods at home, the rest imported.
note.kk: Өз пікірі: негізгі азық-түлік — өзімізде, қалғаны — импорт.
note.ru: Собственное мнение: базовые продукты — своё, остальное — импорт.

note.en: Conclusion: both sides in one sentence, the final position in the next.
note.kk: Қорытынды: бір сөйлемде екі тарап, екіншісінде соңғы ұстаным.
note.ru: Вывод: обе стороны в одном предложении и итоговая позиция во втором.

document.title: Local or imported food
document.question:
Some people believe that countries should produce most of their own food rather than relying on imports. Others argue that importing food from other countries is cheaper and gives consumers more choice.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
